compositionEvidence.summary: Attempt-2 draft unwraps the valid accepted-part assembly to the canonical root world object and keeps the composition as one asymmetrical diagonal warm-earth burst with surrounding scraped counterspace.
decisions: Camera is copied unchanged from the supplied default world contract; framing is solved only through accepted part transforms.
The prior attempt failed because the draft was nested under top-level world; this draft writes the immersive-world-v1 object at the root so world.parts is canonical for preview materialization.
Primary diagonal-burst-plane-structure remains the largest front-mid structure to avoid an accidental inset in the desktop frame while keeping the mobile crop filled by the diagonal sweep.

Open-scraped-counterspace, scumbled-painted-skin, and level-work-strata stay layered behind and through the main structure to preserve scraped gaps, dark passages, tactile matte skin, and unfinished multi-level depth.

Concentrated-advance-flow-knot and calligraphic-edge-pressure stay forward enough to make the measured 3-2 pressure knot and pale/dark edge rhythm readable without replacing the accepted module refs or becoming literal sports imagery.
The world environment remains quiet technical support with warm-earth field color; the surrounding shell prevents accidental empty 360 directions without taking creative ownership.

takeaways: Router chose visual validation plus exposure/color grading only; no implementation-side graphics skill was needed because composition changes are part transforms and renderer-owned grade.
Validation focus is fixed-camera preview evidence and canonical draft identity; no-post or diagnostic variants are not available in this work-session command surface.
Exposure/color grading remains a single subtle renderer-owned final grade and is not used to compensate for weak part placement.

rendererCompatibility.reason: All accepted moduleRef identities, assetRefs arrays, and accepted WebGPU compatibility facts are preserved; no WebGL-only surfaces, shader materials, GLSL passes, or remote assets were introduced.
